_comment: Declared spend ceilings for agent work on this venture, per the cost plane.
Amounts are integer minor units (USD cents) so no budget is a float.
Crossing 'warn' reports and continues; crossing 'stop' halts the run and
waits for a human. A run with no enforced ceiling is the one failure mode
an autonomous lifecycle cannot recover from on its own.
'meter' names the read-only command that reports accumulated usage for
this venture, so the capability preflight can prove the ceilings are
measured rather than merely written down. Null means no meter is readable
from this workspace; the preflight records that, and the metering
checklist item resolves against the record instead of waiting for a
